item.title: 3.0.0-alpha.10
item.description:
macOS 27 only · Build 115

New

  • Moving an item from its menu says how it went. After a move from the Thaw Bar or search, a short message says where the item went, or that it didn't move. By @diazdesandi.
  • Move items with a thaw:// link. thaw://move-item puts one or more items into Visible, Hidden or Always Hidden, optionally right after another item, the same way a drop in Layout does. Apps need your approval in Automation first. See docs/URI_SCHEMES.md. By @diazdesandi.
  • Restart the menu bar from Settings. Tools › Troubleshooting has a Restart Menu Bar button for when the menu bar gets stuck, for example on top of full-screen apps. Your layout is kept, and Thaw relaunches afterward. By @diazdesandi.
  • Move several items at once in Layout. Command-click or Shift-click icons to select them, then drag any of them or right-click to move them all to another section in one go. Press Escape or click an empty spot to clear the selection. By @diazdesandi.

Removed

  • Thaw Bar Only is gone. It was already switched off, and its launcher icon, shortcut and stand-in icons went with it. Items you kept there are ordinary Hidden items. By @diazdesandi.

Changed

  • A move macOS ignores falls back sooner. When macOS doesn't act on a move, Thaw starts dragging the icon after 0.7 seconds instead of 1.2. By @diazdesandi.

Changed: Settings

  • Tools lists the resets before your layout backups. Layout backups moved to the bottom of the page, so Troubleshooting and Reset come first. By @diazdesandi.
  • Troubleshooting has two fewer buttons. "Reset Control Center" is gone: on macOS 27 it also erased your choices in System Settings > Menu Bar, and "Restore Missing Items" brings items back without deleting anything. "Quit and Clear Cache" is gone too: saved item pictures are now thrown away after every update, which is what that button was for. By @diazdesandi.
  • Search lists every section in menu bar order. The order buttons and the per-section switches under Menu bar search are gone. By @diazdesandi.
  • Privacy has no Turn Everything Off button. It switched off the two rows above it; turn those off directly. By @diazdesandi.
  • Allow an app for thaw:// links by choosing it. Automation > Other apps > Choose App… opens a file picker instead of asking for a bundle ID. By @diazdesandi.
  • Automation is one short page. Each row says what's set right now. Display and Space switching open in a sheet, and a script's timeout and on/off switch are in its ⋯ menu. By @diazdesandi.
  • Simple Mode has an All Settings button in the toolbar, so you don't have to find Simple Mode in the ⋯ menu to leave it. By @diazdesandi.
  • "Show an item when its icon changes" moved to Visibility and lost its cooldown slider. The same item can show itself again after 45 seconds, the old default. By @diazdesandi.
  • Spaces is part of Displays. The page is now Displays & Spaces, with This Space and All Spaces below the display settings. Links and searches for Spaces open it. By @diazdesandi.
  • Triggers moved to Automation. They're under "When an app runs", and links to Triggers open Automation. By @diazdesandi.
  • One choice for how a spacing change applies. "When spacing changes" asks first, restarts menu bar apps right away, or waits until they restart. It replaces a picker and a switch and keeps what you had set. "Save spacing to every profile" is a switch now too. By @diazdesandi.
  • The spacing sliders fill out from Default, so you can see whether you made spacing tighter or wider. By @diazdesandi.
  • The buttons in triggers and the Recovery window match the rest of Settings. By @diazdesandi.
  • The Nightly update channel is called Alpha, matching the version numbers it delivers. You stay on it. By @diazdesandi.

Fixed

  • The tint and shape step aside in every full-screen app. With the menu bar set to stay shown, they slid down onto the app's toolbar, or covered the menu bar items. Reported by @Parakeet709 in #1229. By @diazdesandi.
  • Switching profiles no longer turns off Always Hidden or "Move items that don't fit into Hidden". A profile saved before you turned them on switched them back off whenever a display or Space changed. A profile can still turn Always Hidden on. By @diazdesandi.
  • Zen Mode keeps hover from revealing hidden items until you turn it off. The lock came undone the next time a section hid, so Zen Mode seemed to do nothing. By @diazdesandi.
  • "Always show hidden items" stays on. On a display where it's turned on, hidden items no longer hide again after a few seconds, and moving the pointer to another display no longer shows or hides them. By @malash.
  • Moving an item lands where you put it more often. Before it moves an icon, Thaw checks that the icons around the new spot haven't moved, and it reads every saved position back from macOS. A move that didn't stick switches to dragging right away instead of waiting. By @diazdesandi.
  • Showing hidden items no longer reshuffles the visible ones. When a hidden item had ended up among your visible items, showing the hidden section also rewrote the position of every visible item, which could move icons like Wi-Fi. By @diazdesandi.
  • Moving an item into a hidden section sticks. Thaw waited for the icon to move while its section was hidden, gave up, and after two tries stopped saving its position. It now saves the position right away, and the icon takes it the next time the section is shown. By @diazdesandi.
  • An app with several icons keeps each one where you put it. One of Droppy's icons could be saved under an entry macOS doesn't use, so it slid back into Hidden. By @diazdesandi.
  • A ⌘-drag isn't undone by Thaw's next write. macOS saves every icon's position the moment a drag ends, and Thaw could overwrite that with what it had read just before. Thaw now leaves alone any position that changed since it last looked. By @diazdesandi.
  • Repairs no longer swap icons that were already in order, and hidden items moved back beside a divider keep the order you set instead of coming back reversed. By @diazdesandi.
  • Thaw leaves Clock, Control Center, Live Activities and the camera indicator to macOS, which places them itself, instead of saving positions macOS ignores. By @diazdesandi.
  • Two apps with the same saved position no longer swap places after a restart. macOS breaks the tie by which app started first; Thaw now gives them their own positions when it rewrites that part of the menu bar. By @diazdesandi.
  • A failed save can no longer wipe macOS's saved menu bar positions. When that file couldn't be read, Thaw wrote a new one in its place and lost every other item's position. Now it leaves the file alone. By @diazdesandi.
  • Turning on Always Hidden no longer sweeps your items into it. Its divider could appear on the wrong side of the Hidden divider and stay there, and the next ⌘-drag then moved every item past it into Always Hidden. Thaw now puts the dividers back in order and ignores them while they are out of order. By @diazdesandi.
  • Items you move stay put when Thaw restarts or a display changes. With a profile active, Thaw re-applied that profile's layout after every launch, display change and app restart, undoing anything you had moved since. It now applies a profile only when it switches to it. Reported in #1314. By @diazdesandi.
  • Showing Hidden no longer shuffles items that are already in place. With Always Hidden on, Thaw judged Hidden items against Always Hidden's divider while that section was closed, where macOS leaves the divider beside the Hidden one. It then moved every Hidden item, one by one, to where it already was. By @diazdesandi.
  • Showing a hidden section no longer rewrites positions that are already right. Thaw rewrote the spacing of every item in the section each time it was shown, which made macOS lay the bar out again. It now leaves them alone when they're already in order. By @diazdesandi.
  • A passing jumble no longer becomes your layout. Thaw saved the live order every few seconds, including the moment after a wake, a display change or an app adding an icon, and then kept putting that order back. It now waits until the menu bar has been settled for twelve seconds, which outlasts the rewrite macOS makes ten seconds after an icon appears. By @diazdesandi.
  • An app with several icons no longer sets off a chain of repairs. When macOS didn't move one of them, Thaw counted it as a failure, tried again on every reveal and re-spaced the items around it. When it can't tell whether a move worked, because the app has another icon or an item came or went meanwhile, Thaw now leaves that icon alone for a while. By @diazdesandi.
  • Thaw stops rearranging the menu bar on its own if its repairs keep going. When automatic passes write more than four times in 30 seconds while you're not using the menu bar, they pause for a minute. Using the menu bar ends the pause. By @diazdesandi.
  • Thaw no longer puts its dividers back in order while hiding is changing. macOS holds the menu bar's order still while it hides or shows items and for a few seconds after, so a fix written then was wasted or set off another one. Thaw now waits until the menu bar has settled. By @diazdesandi.
  • Using the menu bar stops Thaw's background tidying. Starting a ⌘-drag, opening an item from the Thaw Bar, search or a hint, or showing a hidden section now calls off any automatic repair Thaw had planned, instead of letting it run on a menu bar you just changed. A layout you're looking at while a section is shown is also never saved as your order. By @diazdesandi.
  • Rearranging your displays is handled like plugging one in. Thaw used to wait for the menu bar to settle only when the number of displays changed. Swapping a display, moving one in System Settings or picking another main display now gets the same wait, and Thaw doesn't save the order while an icon is still at the screen's left edge or above the menu bar. By @diazdesandi.
  • Hidden items stay hidden in Manual arrangement when an app starts. Each time an app with a menu bar icon launched or restarted, or a display changed, Thaw read every item's section from where macOS had last placed it, which could move all your Hidden items back into Visible. It now does that only once, when Thaw itself starts. Reported by @promonteiro89 in #1357. By @diazdesandi.
  • Icons that turn up late after login get sorted. Some apps add their menu bar icons a minute or more after you log in, and Thaw could miss them until something else changed. It now takes a quick look 20, 40, 60 and 90 seconds after it starts, and only does anything if the set of icons changed. By @diazdesandi.

item.title: 3.0.0-beta.2
item.description:
macOS 27 only · Build 112

New

  • Triggers can show items while an app runs, even in the background. When it quits, they go back to your saved layout. Added by @diazdesandi in #1223.
  • Launchers can open menu bar items and apply profiles through thaw:// URLs. Floe works without setup. Added by @diazdesandi in #1223.
  • Restore missing menu bar items, in Troubleshooting, brings back stuck items and keeps your saved layout. Added by @diazdesandi in #1223.
  • Gradients can run at any angle. A new slider in Appearance sets it. Gradients you already use look the same. Suggested by Danilo Carvalho (danmnesiac) on Discord. Added by @diazdesandi.
  • Layout shows when macOS won't let an icon follow its section. A badge on the item explains why. Added by @camguillory in #1254.

Changed

  • Automatic overflow is off by default. If you set it yourself, your choice stays. By @diazdesandi in #1223.
  • A gold app icon and a matching accent color. By @diazdesandi in #1223.
  • About has a new layout, a sidebar entry and a Credits page. By @diazdesandi in #1223.
  • Release notes and Credits use the same text sizes as Settings. By @diazdesandi in #1223.
  • Menu bar history is gone, with its click history and unused-item suggestions. Thaw clears the recorded history on launch. Layout backups and hidden items are unaffected. By @diazdesandi in #1223.

Fixed: missing icons and search

  • Thaw says when macOS is blocking its icon. A warning under "Show Thaw icon" points you to System Settings > Menu Bar. Reported by @promonteiro89 in #1232. Fixed by @diazdesandi in #1223.
  • Thaw warns when apps it hid are still hidden after a launch where it couldn't show them again. The warning in General opens Tools, where you can restore them. Fixed by @diazdesandi in #1223.
  • Items show in the menu bar again with the Thaw Bar turned off. The bar could show only the section markers. Reported by @daschles in #1228. Fixed by @diazdesandi in #1223.
  • Menu bar search keeps the keyboard after a search with no matches, and when you open it again. Reported by Jam and krossen6 on Discord. Fixed by @diazdesandi in #1223.

Fixed: items and previews

  • Layout previews follow each item's current position. Fixed by @diazdesandi in #1223.
  • Simple Mode previews stay up to date. Fixed by @diazdesandi in #1223.
  • Amphetamine, Rectangle and OneDrive stay hidden across title changes and restarts. Reported by Mason_Boom and xX-Mordran-Xx on Discord. Fixed by @diazdesandi in #1223.
  • Items parked off the menu bar no longer count toward overflow. Fixed by @diazdesandi in #1223.
  • Clock, Control Center and Siri stay in view with Live Activities and the camera indicator shown. Fixed by @diazdesandi in #1223.

Fixed: appearance, Thaw Bar and Displays

  • Appearance detects a menu bar that hides automatically. Reported by @lyramsr in #1217. Fixed by @diazdesandi in #1223.
  • Split pills cover status items on secondary displays. Fixed by @diazdesandi in #1223.
  • Clicking Thaw's icon after it moves no longer closes and reopens the Thaw Bar. Fixed by @diazdesandi in #1223.
  • The Thaw Bar no longer turns gray with black icons when "Thaw Bar own look" is off. Reported by @scsyc in #1222. Fixed by @diazdesandi in #1223.
  • "When applying spacing" is back in Displays. "Wait until next restart" saves the spacing without relaunching apps. Reported by @netheremp in #1230. Fixed by @diazdesandi in #1223.

Fixed: moving and arranging

  • Moves work while another app is slow to respond. One busy app, such as Google Drive in the middle of a sync, used to block every move. Fixed by @camguillory in #1233.
  • Reordering in Layout works with the Thaw icon hidden. Drops used to save the order without moving anything. Fixed by @camguillory in #1234.
  • Dragging one Stats item moves only that item. After updating, you may need to place your Stats items once more. Fixed by @camguillory in #1235.
  • A second display no longer scrambles your saved order. Items used to jump to the end of the menu bar after a reveal. Fixed by @camguillory in #1241.
  • Some items no longer take seconds to move. Thaw drags them right away. Fixed by @camguillory in #1251.

Fixed: saved order and Manual arrangement

  • A new or temporary icon no longer scrambles your order. When an item arrives, Thaw keeps the order you saved. Reported by HiroMike on Discord. Fixed by @diazdesandi in #1223.
  • Layout works in Manual arrangement. You can drag, sort and use the keyboard there to move items between sections. Reported by HiroMike on Discord. Fixed by @diazdesandi in #1223.

Fixed: icons in Layout and the Thaw Bar

  • Stats icons show up where they used to be blank or out of date. Fixed by @camguillory in #1236.
  • Items that report an oversized icon appear in Thaw. You can now show, hide and move them. Fixed by @camguillory in #1240.
  • Layout keeps real icons while you work in another app. They used to turn into app icons after 30 seconds. Fixed by @camguillory in #1246.
  • Icons next to a hidden Thaw icon keep their real look. Fixed by @camguillory in #1247 and #1252.
  • Icons with their own background keep it, such as Krisp's white square. Fixed by @camguillory in #1264.

Fixed: several displays and a full menu bar

  • Icons load sooner in Layout with several displays. They could take about 19 seconds and show app icons in the meantime. Fixed by @camguillory in #1248.
  • Thaw recognizes the menu bar's overflow arrow in every language. On non-English systems Thaw could save it as an app's icon, and opening the Thaw Bar made icons blink. Fixed by @camguillory in #1257.
  • Clicks in empty menu bar space work on a full notched bar. Right-clicking opens Thaw's menu there, and click, hover and scroll show your items. Fixed by @camguillory in #1258.
  • The Thaw Bar shows real icons when the menu bar is full, where it used to show an app icon for every item. Fixed by @camguillory in #1259.
  • A Thaw Bar opened at the pointer stays put. It used to jump across the screen when you moved the mouse over an item. Fixed by @camguillory in #1249.

Fixed: menus and permissions

  • Menus opened from the Thaw Bar appear at their icon. They could open at the top-left corner of the screen. Reported by @steermomo in #1225 and confirmed by @daschles. Fixed by @diazdesandi.
  • System Settings no longer opens behind the Screen Recording prompt. Thaw waits for your answer first. Fixed by @camguillory in #1243.

item.title: 3.0.0-beta.1
item.description:
macOS 27 only · Build 111 · First beta

Important

This is the first 3.0.0 beta.

Beta is the default update channel. Nightly gets every build as it lands. Switch it in About Thaw, from the ⋯ menu in Settings.

Note

Missing a fix?

If your issue isn't fixed in this build, comment on it. Thank you to everyone who sent logs, recordings and crash reports.

Note

A leaner Thaw

We're trimming, tidying and improving the interface over the next betas. If something feels cluttered, confusing or missing, tell us on GitHub or Discord. Help is appreciated.

Tip

The short version

What's new

  • New option to show Live Activities and the camera indicator while apps are hidden.
  • Folders, opening items by letter, and rounded screen corners.
  • Pick the icon Thaw shows for any item.
  • Open hidden items in the menu bar, under their own icon.
  • One menu for every item, and fewer settings.

What's fixed

  • Settings no longer crashes on notched MacBooks, or at 110% zoom.
  • Passwords' menu bar key can move to Hidden.
  • "Who arranges items" is now Item arrangement, and says what it does.
  • Thaw no longer reorders the menu bar around its own icons, or when it runs out of room.
  • The camera and microphone indicators stay in view with the Live Activities option on.
  • Fast User Switching, AirDrop, Focus and Now Playing stay reachable.
  • macOS's » button works again on notched MacBooks.

Thanks to your support, Thaw is now part of the Vercel Open Source Program.

New: folders, letters and corners

  • Folders. Right-click an item group and choose Show as a Folder. Each folder can have its own icon and color.
  • Open an item by letter with a shortcut from Settings > Shortcuts.
  • Rounded screen corners in Settings > Appearance.

New: icons and menus

  • Thaw uses the app's own icon where it has no picture of an item. Reported by @mrleblanc101 in #1087.
  • Choose Icon… picks any image the app ships, or a file of your own. Requested by @Snowman833 in #912.
  • One menu for every item in Layout, search and the Thaw Bar.

New: show Live Activities and the camera indicator

  • A new option in Settings > General keeps Live Activities and the camera and microphone indicators on the menu bar while apps are hidden, and stops hidden items from flashing when Notification Center opens.
  • It's in beta and off by default. Thaw offers it once at launch and asks for access to one file.
  • The camera and microphone indicator stays in Visible. It could land among hidden items and stay out of sight.
  • An app Control Center doesn't know stays on the bar instead of switching the option back to the usual hiding, which hid the indicators again.

New: open hidden items in the menu bar

  • Open hidden items in the menu bar, in Settings > Thaw Bar, shows a hidden item in the menu bar and opens its menu under the icon, from the Thaw Bar, search or a shortcut. Off, the menu opens without the icon, as before.
  • An app that ignores the click still opens without its icon.

Apple's items Thaw can't hide

Switches in Settings > Experiments swap these for Thaw icons you can move or hide.

  • New: Replace Input Menu, with your keyboard layouts.
  • Fast User Switching, AirDrop, Focus and Now Playing are replaced wherever they sit. Reported by @joaofrgomes in #1196.
  • Replacement icons look right and survive a relaunch.

Settings

  • Update channels. Choose Beta or Nightly in About Thaw, from the ⋯ menu in Settings.
  • An update's notes open in What's New before you install.
  • Item arrangement says what Automatic and Manual do. Reported by @KyNorthstar in #1212.
  • Dashed and dotted borders in Appearance.
  • Fewer settings. Anything you changed still applies.
  • Tidier pages, buttons and sidebar: one shorter list, a subtitle under each pane title, and Swap, Zen Mode and About in the toolbar's menu.
  • Roomier Layout pane. Each section's bar gets its own card at full width, with its name above it.

Fixed

  • Settings no longer crashes on notched MacBooks or at 110% zoom. Reported by @ifangxiang and @NickBenthem in #1194.
  • Thaw no longer reorders the menu bar around its own icons.
  • Unplugging a display no longer quits menu bar apps. A different spacing on each display used to relaunch every app with a menu bar item, Chrome included. The new spacing now applies the next time those apps launch, or at once with Reapply Spacing. #1215
  • A full menu bar stays in order. When macOS has no room to draw some Visible items, Thaw moves the extra ones to Hidden instead of rearranging the bar again and again.
  • Apps with more than one icon stay where you put them.
  • Items keep their section when you reorder Hidden or Always Hidden in Layout.
  • The menu bar is no longer covered while Thaw updates item pictures.
  • Thaw waits while the screen is locked instead of updating pictures and positions against the lock screen.
  • Apple's items keep their pictures on taller notched menu bars.
  • The menu bar background follows reveals at once, on the right display.
  • The Thaw Bar stays put when the Thaw icon is turned off.
  • A divider you ⌘-drag stays where you put it, and the items it passes change section with it.
  • Manual arrangement keeps sections in step with the menu bar. Drag an item past a divider to change its section; Layout no longer moves items Thaw can't.
  • Hover reveals close again a second after the pointer leaves the menu bar, instead of waiting for a click.
  • The Thaw Bar captures only missing pictures when it opens, instead of revealing the whole section.
  • Hidden items open reliably, and open in the Thaw Bar when the menu bar is full. Reported by @Kodiak-01 in #1115.
  • macOS's » button works on notched MacBooks. Reported by @joaofrgomes in #1195.
  • Passwords' menu bar key can move to Hidden. #1205
  • Siri stays put when you move other items.
  • An app's items stay together, and Layout says when one is hidden with its app.
  • Items hidden beside the notch come back on a wider display. Reported by @shaneoreilly in #1106.
  • Wide items keep their picture. Reported by @thomast8 in #1204.
  • Item pictures survive a relaunch and no longer pick up specks from busy wallpapers.
  • Other apps stay in the background while Settings is open. Reported by @joaofrgomes in #1197.
  • Clicks near the clock in full-screen apps no longer open Notification Center. Reported by @apaeffgen in #1191.
  • Thaw is faster: the accessibility helper starts, and swaps and reveals do less work.

Known issues

  • "Broadcast Message … NSAccessibilityException" in every Terminal window. An older app whose menu bar item uses AppKit's legacy status-item API throws when Thaw reads the item, and macOS broadcasts the error to all terminals. To find the app, run log show --last 10m --style compact --predicate 'eventMessage CONTAINS "NSAccessibilityException"' while it happens; the process name in each line is the app. Quitting or updating that app stops the messages. #1214

Still under investigation

  • Thaw may not stay the frontmost app. Tell us if it still happens. #1167
  • Uneven gaps after a spacing change. #1126
  • Webcam and microphone controls can be hard to reach. #1174
  • Item positions with a right-to-left language. #1063

Thank you

  • @KyNorthstar, the Item arrangement wording (#1212)
  • @ifangxiang and @NickBenthem, the Settings crash (#1194)
  • @joaofrgomes, the » button, Typeface and Fast User Switching (#1195, #1196, #1197)
  • @shaneoreilly, @Kodiak-01 and @thomast8, hidden and wide items (#1106, #1115, #1204)
  • @mrleblanc101 and @Snowman833, item icons (#1087, #912)
  • @apaeffgen, Notification Center (#1191)
  • lyly and influx on Discord, missing items and live wallpapers
  • Andrew, ꩜ツ iamnotacat ツ꩜, xX-Mordran-Xx, Kristian Kruse, katlaland and Fofer on Discord, testing, logs and reports across many issues

macOS 26 only

Hey, we have a website! The docs, the changelog and the roadmap are at getthaw.app.

The feature release for macOS 26 that 2.0.0 promised. Items can move on their own when something happens, related items stay together in groups, Zen Mode closes the whole menu bar with one hotkey, and Simple Mode fits Settings on one page. Screen Recording is now optional. Six betas led here, and most of what changed after the first one came from your reports. The beta entries below have the detail.

After you update:

  1. Profiles, saved layouts and hotkeys carry over. There is nothing to redo.
  2. Trigger conditions other than battery and power stay off until you switch them on under Trigger Sources.
  3. If you'd rather Thaw never restarts apps for a spacing change, set When applying spacing to Wait until next restart in Settings > Displays.
  4. With Homebrew, use the thaw cask. thaw@beta is Thaw 3, which needs macOS 27. #1221
  5. If something looks wrong, open an issue.

New

Triggers

  • Items move when something happens. A trigger can react to battery level, power, an app, the network, a VPN, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, an audio device, a display, a time, a Focus, a place, Energy Mode, heat, the camera or microphone, a script, or another icon changing. Conditions can be combined, and an action can be reversed. By @alvst in #735 and #965.
  • Icon-change triggers can be strict or loose. Loose ignores tiny redraws, strict reacts to any change, and the editor shows the icon it compares against. #1006
  • A trigger can follow an external drive, so a drive's helper app shows while the drive is plugged in. Requested by @lucifercraig12345-create in #1053.

Layout

  • Groups keep related items together. They move and hide as one, even across sections.
  • Spacers add a gap of the width you choose, with an optional fill.
  • Sort a section A to Z from its heading in Layout. #936
  • Layout opens in its own window, and you can open an item straight from it. #985
  • Opened items can stay a while. An item you open from search or the Thaw Bar can stay up to 30 seconds after its menu closes. Set it under Settings > General > After revealing. #342

Modes and profiles

  • Zen Mode closes every section with one hotkey. Hovering, automatic reveals and blinking icons can't open them until you turn it off.
  • Simple Mode shows Settings as one page. Switch it off to get everything back.
  • A profile can follow a Space, the way it already follows a display, and each Space can have its own menu bar look.

Appearance

  • The Thaw Bar has its own shape, tint and border. Requested by @kn666 in #248.
  • A new wallpaper re-tints the menu bar right away, and the adaptive gradient uses the wallpaper's main colours instead of one average.

Smaller things

  • Blinking icons can show themselves. An item that asks for attention briefly opens its section. Off by default, under Advanced.
  • A hotkey for automatic rehiding. By @nightah in #665.
  • Thaw can stay out of the Dock while you show and hide items. Turn on "Hide Dock icon when toggling the menu bar" in General. #1128
  • Remove a display you no longer use from the Per Display list. #1054
  • A Tools pane gathers the troubleshooting helpers.
  • Logs are easier to send. Diagnostic logs rotate on their own, by @nk-tedo-001 in #974. When an automatic move fails, Thaw saves a report you can attach to an issue. #994

Changed

  • Screen Recording is optional. An item Thaw can't capture shows as its app's icon, so the Thaw Bar, Layout and search work without the permission. Turn on "Show app icons instead of live previews" and the recording indicator goes away. #1051
  • Thaw stays out of your way while it moves items. It waits until you stop using the mouse and keyboard, leaves the pointer where you put it, and stops instead of trying the same move again and again. Your own drags always go through.
  • Thaw asks before every automatic app restart when "Confirm before relaunching apps" is on, not only after a display change. #1098
  • Hidden icons refresh as often as the slider says. By @camguillory in #942.
  • Displays has one Per display section instead of a block for each display, and marks displays with their own settings as Custom. #1045
  • "Dev Mode Flags" is now "Trigger Sources".
  • Search, About and the welcome screens follow your text size.
  • More of Thaw is translated, Russian most of all. Help at crowdin.com/project/thaw.

Fixed

Spacing

  • Changing the spacing no longer makes Spotlight disappear until you restart the Mac. Fixed by @commanderk33n in #720.
  • Changing the spacing no longer quits system services that can't be started again, and an app that says no to quitting is left running. Reported by @wiper2 in #1070.
  • The spacing prompt stays away after you cancel it, and "Don't ask again" sticks. #1180

Order and moving

  • Applying a profile no longer pushes your visible items into Hidden. Reported by @nk-tedo-001 in #1027.
  • Reordering items in Hidden works again. #1074, #1102, #1133
  • Items you drop into Always Hidden stay there. #1190
  • New apps land at the "New items" spot, not next to the Thaw icon. #1069
  • A revealed item shows on the right side of the arrow. #1035
  • A move right after an app updates no longer snaps back. Reported by @Chamiu in #1058.
  • The iPhone Mirroring Live Activity can be moved. Reported by @mi3suuu.
  • The Thaw icon stays put when you reconnect a display on a Mac with a notch.
  • An item no longer gets stuck in one place after a rehide fails, and duplicate Control Center items on non-English Macs are cleaned up. Reported by @balaji-dutt in #1079 and #1080.
  • Thaw no longer freezes its item list because of a window left behind by an earlier Thaw. #1032

Menu bar and Thaw Bar

  • Clicking a menu like File no longer opens Hidden in apps such as Firefox. #1028
  • Scrolling on the Thaw icon opens Hidden. #1073
  • A quit app no longer leaves an icon in the Thaw Bar. #1149
  • The Thaw Bar shows the right icons on every display, light or dark, and keeps them. #1065, #1046
  • No empty gap at launch when the Thaw icon is switched off. #1043
  • Clicking one of Apple's own items opens its menu.
  • Thaw no longer acts on a menu bar macOS never finished drawing. Reported by @ppocass in #1060.

Settings and search

  • The search panel takes your first keystroke. #969
  • Typing in the Settings search no longer freezes Thaw, and adding a spacer no longer crashes it. Reported by @lucifercraig12345-create in #1055 and #1056.
  • The Smart rehide delay can be seen and changed. #1049

Memory and speed

  • Thaw's memory grows more slowly over days of uptime. It redraws only what changed and stops capturing while your displays sleep. If you still see it grow, please comment on #1129.
  • Icons refresh without slowing Thaw down, and a blink trigger watches only its own items.

item.title: 1.3.0-beta.1
item.description:
1.3.0-beta.1: Profiles & Reliability

This beta introduces Settings Profiles, allowing you to save and switch between different Thaw configurations. Profiles can be triggered automatically based on display changes or Focus modes.

New Features:

  • Settings Profiles: Save your entire Thaw configuration as a profile and switch between different setups instantly. Perfect for different workflows, presentations, or multi-monitor configurations.
    • Create, duplicate, rename, and delete profiles
    • Import and export profiles for backup or sharing
    • Update existing profiles with current layout, configuration, or both
    Thanks to @nightah for implementing this feature!
  • Display Auto-Switch: Assign profiles to specific displays. When you connect a display, its associated profile is automatically applied.
  • Focus Mode Integration: Switch profiles automatically when Focus modes activate. Add Thaw as a Focus Filter in System Settings → Focus → [Mode] → Focus Filters to assign a profile to each Focus mode. The previous profile is restored when the Focus mode deactivates.
  • Profile Hotkeys: Assign keyboard shortcuts to quickly switch between your favorite profiles.
  • New Items Badge: A draggable badge in Menu Bar Layout settings lets you control exactly where newly detected menu bar items will appear. Drag it to position new items to the left or right of existing icons.
  • Option-Click Always Hidden: New setting to toggle the always-hidden section with Option+click on empty menu bar space.
  • Icon Overflow for Notch Displays: Improved handling of menu bar items on MacBooks with a notch. Items that would be hidden behind the notch are now properly managed.

Improvements & Fixes:

  • App Menu Click-Through: Fixed issues where clicking on application menus (File, Edit, View, etc.) would incorrectly trigger Thaw's show-on-click, hover, or scroll behaviors. App menus now work reliably.
  • Event Monitor Recovery: Added automatic health checking and recovery for background event monitors. If mouse click detection stops working, Thaw now recovers automatically instead of requiring a restart.
  • Layout Bar Stability: Fixed items disappearing from the layout bar during reorder operations, after reset, or when new items appear.
  • New Items Badge Position: Fixed the badge jumping to incorrect positions when reordering other items around it. The badge now stays in place unless explicitly dragged.
  • IceBar Click Responsiveness: Reduced click jitter when interacting with items in the IceBar.
  • Context Menu Size: Fixed context menus appearing unexpectedly large in certain situations.
  • Secondary Display Support: Fixed right-click context menu not working on secondary displays.

This is a beta release. Please report any issues you encounter on GitHub.

1.2.0: Icon Management Evolved

Important Note: This release introduces significant improvements to how Thaw manages menu bar item positions. Your icon positions are now automatically saved and restored across app restarts. If you experience any issues with icon positioning, use the new "Reset Thaw" button in Advanced Settings to restore default settings.

New Features:

  • Icon Position Persistence: Thaw now remembers where your icons belong! Menu bar items are automatically restored to their saved sections (visible, hidden, or always-hidden) after app restarts or system reboots. No more manually re-sorting icons after logging in.
  • Custom Menu Bar Item Names: You can now rename any menu bar item with a custom name of your choice. Perfect for giving cryptic icons a more descriptive label or organizing your workflow.
  • Menu Bar Item Tooltips: Enable optional tooltips that appear when hovering over items in the actual menu bar. Know exactly what each icon represents without clicking.
  • URL Scheme Support: External tools like Raycast can now control Thaw via the thaw:// URL scheme. Toggle the Thaw Bar, show or hide sections, and more using custom commands.
  • Manual Application Menu Toggle: Added a configurable hotkey to manually toggle application menu visibility. Useful for presentations or when you need the full menu bar width temporarily.
  • Thaw Bar Hover Highlight: Items in the Thaw Bar now show a subtle background highlight when hovered, making it easier to identify which item you're about to interact with.
  • Conflicting Apps Detection: Thaw now detects when other menu bar management apps are running and warns you about potential conflicts.
  • Per-Display Settings: Configure "Always show hidden items" and Thaw Bar positioning independently for each connected display. Perfect for multi-monitor setups with different screen sizes or notch configurations.
  • Reset Thaw Button: A new reset button in Advanced Settings allows you to quickly restore all Thaw settings to their defaults when troubleshooting.

Improvements & Fixes:

  • Startup Stability: Fixed the "icon parade" issue where icons would continuously shuffle for 10–15 seconds after login. Thaw now enters a settling period during startup to prevent premature rearrangement.
  • Multi-Icon App Support: Apps with multiple menu bar icons (such as Stats, Hammerspoon, and iStat Menus) now stay properly organized in their designated sections instead of gradually migrating to the visible menu bar over time.
  • Memory Optimizations: Reduced memory usage by skipping wallpaper captures when not needed, clearing stale caches when displays disconnect, and adding proper cleanup for background tasks.
  • Performance: Throttled mouse event handling and optimized image caching to reduce CPU usage and improve overall responsiveness.
  • Privacy: Added screen recording permission checks for tooltips and search features. These options are now hidden in settings when permissions are not granted.
  • Visual Refinements: Improved IceBar item highlight sizing with better corner radius and padding for a more modern appearance that matches macOS design language.
  • Same-Icon Differentiation: Fixed a bug where different apps sharing the same icon were conflated. Thaw now correctly identifies items by their source application.
  • Auto-Rehide Reliability: Improved the rehide logic to prevent items from staying visible longer than intended, and fixed cases where manual hide states could get stuck.

Localization:

Thaw now supports 17 languages with 100% completion! A huge thank you to our community contributors:

  • Bahasa Indonesia: by @volcbs
  • Čeština (Czech): new in this release
  • Deutsch: by @Mutzki13
  • Español: by @diazdesandi
  • Français: by @PipaCode
  • Italiano: by @zichichi
  • 日本語 (Japanese): new in this release
  • 한국어 (Korean): by @YuriHan
  • Magyar (Hungarian): by @johnnybakucz
  • Nederlands (Dutch): by @SeBr28
  • Polski (Polish): new in this release
  • Português (Brasil): new in this release
  • Русский (Russian): new in this release
  • 简体中文 (Chinese Simplified): by @PiCpo
  • 正體中文 (Chinese Traditional): by @7a6163
  • ภาษาไทย (Thai): by @priesdelly
  • Türkçe (Turkish): new in this release

Thank you to everyone who tested the beta versions and provided feedback that made this release possible!

item.title: 1.2.0-rc.4
item.description:
1.2.0-rc.4: Localization Refinement & Stability Improvements

  • Internationalization Updates:
    • Finalized Czech (CS) language updates for the 1.2.0 release cycle.
    • Updated Turkish (TR) translations.
  • Fixes:
    • Reverted "Robust Icon Position Handling" to address regression issues and maintain system stability while the feature is further refined.

1.1.0: Breaking the Ice

⚠️ Important Note: Due to essential internal changes in how Thaw manages menu bar items, your current icon positions will be reset to "Always Visible." I sincerely apologize for the inconvenience, but this manual re-adjustment is unavoidable to ensure future stability.

Localization Support:

Thaw is now available in 12 languages with 100% completion. A huge thank you to our community contributors:

  • Chinese (Simplified): by @PiCpo
  • Chinese (Traditional): by @7a6163
  • Dutch: by @SeBr28
  • French: by @PipaCode
  • German: by @Mutzki13
  • Hungarian: by @johnnybakucz
  • Indonesian: by @volcbs
  • Italian: by @zichichi
  • Korean: by @YuriHan
  • Spanish: by @diazdesandi
  • Thai: by @priesdelly

Changes and Fixes:

  • Multi-Monitor Support: Improved app menu hiding logic to correctly account for screen edges and active menu bars across multiple monitors.
  • Ultra-wide Monitor Fix: Resolved an issue where menu bar items were incorrectly included in calculations, which previously caused "Hidden" and Always Hidden" items to appear incorrectly on the left side of ultra-wide screens.
  • Refined Notch Detection: Implemented auxiliaryTopLeftArea for more accurate notch detection and added an option to enable the IceBar only on displays with a notch.
  • Immediate UI Updates: Menubar shapes (split/full) now update instantly when settings are changed, eliminating the previous 30-second delay.
  • Display-Specific Layouts: Fixed an issue where menu bar items from primary displays were incorrectly included in trailing path calculations for external monitors.
  • Performance Optimizations: Reduced CPU usage by debouncing image cache updates, adding polling delays, and skipping background timer tasks when panels are hidden.
  • Simplified Settings: Removed the redundant "temporary item delay" setting as the smart rehide logic now handles these cases automatically.
  • Thaw Bar Scaling Fix: Resolved a scaling issue in the Thaw Bar by clamping the menu bar content height and capping item height to ensure consistent rendering.
  • New Interaction: Added the ability to double-click directly on the menu bar to reveal the "Always Hidden" section.

1.0.0: The Official Release

Thaw has reached its first stable milestone! This release consolidates all the progress from the beta period into a polished, reliable menu bar manager.

Latest Improvements (since beta 4):

  • Enhanced Reliability: Stabilized HIDEventManager logic to prevent "show on hover" and "show on click" from stopping after repeated use and prevent saving chevron divider position which could leave Thaw in an unusable state.
  • UI Polish: Condensed the menu bar tooltip for a cleaner look and added explicit double-click instructions.
  • System Safety: Improved thread safety by synchronizing access to the cursor hide count.
  • Apple Menu Fix: Refined synthetic press offsets to ensure Thaw never accidentally triggers the Apple menu.

Highlights from the Journey to 1.0:

  • The Big Thaw: Successfully forked and rebranded with a new identity, app icon, and independent bundle ID (com.stonerl.Thaw).
  • Ice Migration: Built-in support to import your old settings and control item positions from Ice.
  • Advanced Control: Introduced "Double-Click to Reveal" for always-hidden items and "Smart Rehide" strategies.
  • Modern macOS Support: Optimized for stability on macOS 26.
  • Performance: Faster icon caching, display-aware state refreshing, and thread-safe operations.

Known Issues:

If you are currently on macOS 14 or 15, please be aware that Thaw currently has some known bugs regarding temporary icons in the floating Thaw bar.

I am actively investigating these issues and will release a fix as soon as possible. You can track the progress of this issue here: GitHub Issue #1.

Thank you for all the feedback during the beta period that made this release possible!
